title: AI 2 rail: every card row gets the default padding and one rhythm

set.request: the visual hierarchy is so bad. Like, there's not enough padding on the preview cards... I like the flush cards... However, then the cards themselves need, if our default padding, if that's our default padding, which it should be, then the default padding system is broken.
set.now: writing the fix in ai2.css and the row-head markup
steps: Measure every rail row's padding and which rule sets it
Write why.md: table plus the cause
Shared-page before/after shots and layout-check (if shared CSS changed)
set.outcome:
**Every row in the AI 2 rail now uses the site's default card padding and one even rhythm.** The padding system was fine; AI 2's rows never used it, hand-padding 8.8 x 11.2px instead.

![after](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-rail-rhythm/shots/after-rail-zoom.png)

- [x] default padding: 16px (--pad-card) on every row kind, measured; [why.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-rail-rhythm/why.md)
- [x] flush container, no gap: rows edge to edge, one hairline apart; [before](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-rail-rhythm/shots/before-ai2-1920.png) / [after](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-rail-rhythm/shots/after-ai2-1920.png)
- [x] one cadence: same 5.6px step between title, count and the what-happened bar
- [x] is the default padding system broken? No, tested in why.md

Also: titles drop paragraph spacing, the time sits on the first line, the Live card's fold no longer touches the edge when narrow. Reviewed: pass, 1 fixed. Left: merging the branch is the mastermind's call.
